notes.title: Demo update 👀
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We're excited to share some great news with you all. Our first Akatori demo is on the horizon! We proudly present Akatori: Chapter One, and it will be available for free on Steam. This demo boasts two full-scale locations, the beginning of the game's storyline, a range of upgrades, and a thrilling boss fight.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Right now we’re actively working on level design and environment, therefore in this update we’d like to tell you about interesting finds you can come across in the world of Aarkalia.

As we have already mentioned, the world of Aarkalia is divided into two parts, and our heroine is able to travel between the present and the future, exploring both realms. In the game, there’ll be a system of quests given by NPCs — sometimes these quests will be linked between worlds: in order to solve some of the riddles, you’ll have to change something in the present, so that it plays a role in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/c8d3b7e22819fa95113eb07fb75a1d68872e1300.png

One of such NPCs, Ina Tsukumo, is the head of the Museum of Rare Birds of Aarkalia. She will ask you to find her lost birds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/47a3812b8004aa04c2e0f0abf2a44ca7366c1567.png

Also, as you explore the world, the heroine may discover strange purple gems. An unknown person nicknamed the Ambassador, who travels through the worlds, will tell the heroes about their function.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/e0d60ba54b63b48b8850d50f1b90072d511676a6.gif

With the help of gems, the heroine will be able to acquire blessings — special passive properties that will remain with the character, strengthening her forever. Combined with some amulets, the right blessings will significantly strengthen the character, emphasizing the specific playstyle. There are three skill trees in total: inspiration, vitality and courage, and each of the trees has nodes that enhance the character in a certain way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/7217d166333045e1d695a8de0d7512be960975a5.png

In the previous update we showed you the lost quiver. From now on, with each update, we will talk about some of the amulets that can be found in the game. Since amulets can be equipped in two types of slots, each of them will have two properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/f9e55028d25ba4a44da04f3fbf9646822c5e05f7.png

In the next update we’ll tell you more about the Warm Winds Charm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/5ec6e073bc25075919dad582e3eb2bceea0babb3.png

We're also encouraging you to follow our Kickstarter page, more news about the campaign are coming soon 💚

notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for your support. Due to some minor issues, development has slowed down a bit lately — however, we’re now happy to report that we’re making significant progress indeed, and many things related to development organization are back to normal. We hope to meet your expectations in the nearest future 🙏


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/c95c56b84204812310db9e94067b9e43f89055f1.png

While working on the alpha version, we came to the conclusion that in order to release a public demo, we need to achieve the right level of polish and amount of content in that upcoming demo, and we’ll need a little more time for that. That is why we had to postpone certain activities. At this stage, we can say with confidence that the key components of the gameplay and mechanics are already working, so we’re putting all our efforts into filling the game with content. On the one hand, we’d like to save some interesting details for the future, however, there are some things that we can show right now and even tease some small features.


Our Discord server residents could have noticed a hint about one of the game’s bosses for quite a while now, since from the moment the server was created we had this special turtle emote.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/da843b87c9d138ac78a189d788abf7741bfff61b.png

Meet Monumental Ao (we've had a hard time animating him, honestly)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/e104bb875031890af8fa130776877f6674cbe71b.gif

Meet Melissa, a wandering merchant who travels all over Aarkalia with her impromptu food truck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/e747dd1d785335528d893d00ab00e763d63c75c2.gif

You can visit Melissa at any time and purchase interesting things that can help you on your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/dbb4d2e5d71ccb286d9d03b70ab92bd6f9db7425.png

We're also updated some of the screenshots on the page, with cool new content, take a look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/7561d9e41d30eb60db8d43f844e6dffd4bd2ec1f.png

By the way, while we were chatting, Mako found this, apparently lost by some Priestess... Not a word to anyone, okay?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967200/9eb6937f58870faf884747f7b8bd3273cf568cd6.png


Try out one of our friendly developers prologue on the 7th of February, called MAGO: The Villain's Burger! 

The game is a 2D platformer that puts us in the boots of a sorcerer, who was unfortunate enough to eat evil overlord's food. Now he has to rescue his beloved princess from the dinner menu of the evil Gourmet! Nostalgia awaits!
